scope: Official Impulse:Terrain preset listing demo inspected read-only through rendered browser accessibility trees. No shopper interactions, screenshot, viewport, mobile, editor, checkout or performance testing.

sources.observation: Official Shopify Impulse:Terrain preset listing View demo opened the sports storefront.

claims.observed: Home combines cycling campaign media, featured products, category links and service propositions; All collection exposes 62 products, four facet types, sorting and pagination; PDP presents size controls, specifications and service sections; empty cart includes shopping continuation and product recommendations.
claims.risk: No interaction was performed, and product specifications, size fit, stock, recommendations and service copy are not verified.
claims.vsn_guard: Test sport-specific filters and fit-selection behavior with real catalog data; substantiate technical, inventory, warranty and delivery claims.

claims.observed: The demo displays model names/specifications, sale and service promotions, testimonial, warranties, shipping and assembly statements.
claims.risk: Visible copy includes mixed-era references and merchant claims that have not been validated.
claims.vsn_guard: Audit product/story consistency and validate all pricing, promotion timing, reviews, warranties and fulfillment content before reuse.
